description: [PAID $0.002 USDC per call via x402 on Base; errors are free] Look up one transaction on Base mainnet by hash: status (success, failed or pending), block, timestamp, confirmations, from/to, value, method id, gas used, effective gas price, fee split into L2 execution and L1 data fee (ETH and USD), contract created, and decoded ERC-20 Transfer events (token, symbol, from, to, amount; up to 20). Useful to confirm a payment landed. Read live from public Base RPC. All params optional: defaults to a confirmed USDC x402 payment. Unknown hash = 404, invalid hash = 400, never charged.

hash.description: Transaction hash (0x + 64 hex). Optional: defaults to 0x20215b4a54f0a39995f3afbd748d7b52c3a1922685ddf08e5f694ea1e89b52bf.
